name: Mask
summary: Bronze。26.4 × 32.2 × 0.3 cm (10 1/2 × 12 7/8 × 3/32 in.)。Lucy Maud Buckingham Collection
history: The function of this mask is not certain. It may have served as a bridle plaque for a horse, an ornament for a chariot, or, sewn onto leather, as chest armor for a soldier.

images.credit: 芝加哥艺术馆 Lucy Maud Buckingham Collection
